report.explanation: Order service shows only a small, non-sustained retained-bytes bump (10→40→20 bytes, far below the 33,554,432-byte limit) with releases occurring and GC completing; the service is healthy (5 successes, 0 errors, ~1µs p95). This does not establish a memory leak or any bounded fault, so no candidate is asserted and the incident is handed off.
missing_evidence: Sustained multi-interval retained-bytes growth with releases near zero to substantiate a leak
Alert definition or symptom description for expanded-case-01 to bound the fault
Latency/error telemetry showing user-visible impact on order service
